fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: Leader of the Freedom Front Plus (Vryheidsfront Plus)
rows.text: The release dated 22-07-2024 begins "Die aanwysing van die VF Plus se leier, dr. Pieter Groenewald, as minister van korrektiewe dienste" (the appointment of the Freedom Front Plus's leader, Dr Pieter Groenewald, as Minister of Correctional Services) required minor changes to the party's parliamentary team.

rows.role_title: Parliamentary leader of the Freedom Front Plus (parlementêre leier)
rows.text: The same release says that Dr. Corné Mulder "is aangewys as die party se parlementêre leier. Hy was voorheen die hoofsweep" (was designated as the party's parliamentary leader; he was previously the chief whip).
